g.text: wait, u taught Arthur how emoticons work?? THANK U
Yep, sat him down and explained the whole thing. He was so confused at first.
Just doing my part to keep the team literate.
You know, I can tell when you're upset.
gosh I am so grateful! now he won’t think I'm challenging him to a duel every time I use “;)”
Haha please tell me that didn't really happen.
Oh Arthur... I guess nobody's perfect.
good guess! I use that one a lot because it's so darn versatile, but it's not my fave
of course u can. we manic pixie dream girls wear our hearts on her sleeves
ding ding ding! we have a winner! how did u know?
Okay, I admit that calling your interest in me a "manic pixie dream girl act" was inconsiderate.
When I said that manic pixie thing, I only meant you don't have to put on an act for me.
I can't believe he actually apologized! all thx to u <3
oooo not quite but that one's up there!
u get one more guess, but only cuz ur so cool
It's just the right mix of cute and witty.
at least u found it "cute and all"
wut makes u think its an act?
I live to serve, my lady.
It was the least I could do.
Well, it was. You're cute. I mean unbelievably cute. I just find it hard to believe.
Nobody's actually bubbly and fun all the time.
I can see a deeper side to you, Aoi. You're tough. You're more than pop songs and emoticons.
u srsly might have just saved us from a lifetime of confusion
Well, now I know something you love, and I'll never forget it.
how am I supposed to receive that?
nobody's serious and boring all the time either
it concerns me that u don't think depth, toughness, pop songs, and emoticons can go together
Glad I could help. So, of all the emoticons you've memorized, which is your favorite?
Hey, Arthur was missing out. Your emoticons are fun. Which is your favorite?
Ooooh I can see why that would be your favorite.
It makes you happy that I've given up?
I knew it was that one.
yet there's always more to uncover ;)
Listen, I think you're amazing. I said that manic pixie crap because I doubt myself, not you. I'm sorry.
I'd like it if you received it as me thinking you're awesome.
at least nobody I want to be around
that might be true for u, but that doesn't mean it's true for everyone
whatever I did to deserve u in my life, I hope no time-travelling mischief-maker ever goes back and changes it <3
I get that u have bad days. who doesn't, right?
I just don't buy that making people happy is your whole reason for being. There's gotta be more to you than that.
Okay, fair point. You're right. What I said was more about me than you.
LOL I never should have doubted u
but u can't just take it out on me cuz I seem "cute" enough to put up with it
maybe u just haven't been paying attention
I was revealing my fave emoticon!
You're right. You deserve better. I'll earn back your faith in me. That's a promise.
So you want me to just hide it from you when I've had a bad day?
I get that u have bad days. who doesn't, right?
ur introspection is awfully charming, I admit
u know that's not what I mean
but u can't just take it out on me cuz I seem nice enough to put up with it
I do like the sound of that promise...
Okay it was a bad joke.
ok let's put this behind us
If that's what you'd like, it's what I'd like.
Okay maybe I'm being a little... avoidant.
look I'm gonna put this behind us, ok?
(in case you don't know, ttyl means "talk to you later")
